methods.name: downloadOwnHistoryAcrossTdfs
methods.notes: Existing authenticated-self token issuance retained; ordinary exports exclude historical assessment copies.

methods.name: editCourse

methods.name: ensureDashboardCacheCurrent

Acceptance shares the per-user transactional content-use guard with instruction and primitive decisions.

methods.name: getAdaptiveOutcomeRows

methods.name: getAllTeachers

methods.name: getClassPerformanceByTDF

methods.name: getLearningHistoryForUnit

methods.name: getProgressiveAssignmentLaunch

methods.name: getSparcHistoryForUnit

methods.name: listSparcLibraryImages
methods.notes: Indexed cursor listing of all completed shared teaching figures or one selected current semantic cluster. Returns at most 24 descriptions, models, dates and reuse states; no embeddings, learner identifiers or private supported-Prompt assets. Group pages reject stale snapshots and invalid cursors.

methods.name: getSparcLibraryClusters
methods.notes: Builds or reads a server-only derived browsing snapshot with two automatically selected semantic levels: topics and subgroups. Shared administrator model labels bounded representative descriptions and authored target texts; no identities, responses or embeddings are sent to the labeler or returned to the browser. Cluster membership and cache leases are separate from instructional retrieval.

methods.name: replaceSparcLibraryImage
methods.notes: Explicit administrator raster upload only; bounded PNG/JPEG/WebP validation, expected-current conflict check and idempotent immutable assets. A Mongo transaction publishes version history and the library current pointer together after durable file storage; no provider call or AI replacement primitive. Saved decisions are unchanged.

methods.name: getStudentPerformanceByIdAndTDFIdFromHistory
methods.notes: Existing subject/lesson authorization retained; original assessment and adaptive-practice histories share the copy exclusion rule.

methods.name: getStudentPerformanceForClassAndTdfId
methods.notes: Existing instructor authorization and enrollment scope retained; aggregates count original histories once.

methods.name: getTdfById
methods.notes: Existing lesson/course access checks retained; authenticated runtime reads exclude the server-owned conditionAllocation block.

methods.name: getVideoCompletedCheckpointQuestionCountFromHistory
methods.notes: Retains existing authenticated-self scope and exact lesson/unit query. Completed checkpoints include correct and incorrect ATTEMPT outcomes; no learner records are changed.

methods.name: incrementTdfConditionCount
methods.notes: Existing root access required. not-max milestone increments must match the caller's saved condition; beginning increments belong exclusively to the allocation transaction.

methods.name: initializeDashboardCache
methods.notes: Authenticated-self or administrator for another existing user. Full reconstruction is an initialization/repair operation; projected source history and cache position share one snapshot transaction.

methods.name: insertHistory
methods.notes: Authenticated-self and lesson/course write authorization retained. Assessment copies rejected. Worksheet and SPARC transition identities are validated; server-derived record IDs deduplicate retries using Mongo uniqueness. Conflicting sequence or transition writes fail. Competitive and student-selected AutoTutor policies and model/OET facts require an admin account at the common history-write boundary. SPARC assessment arrays are admin-only, limited to 256 records and 1 MiB, share one authorized lesson/attempt/response/course/policy scope, contain score-change rows followed by completion, and persist atomically in a Mongo transaction. All accepted single and batch history rows commit their server-owned per-user source sequence in the same transaction; duplicate durable writes allocate no new sequence, and practice saves never rebuild dashboard summaries. Actual SPARC tutor output also checks exact per-user content eligibility and records presentation-use metadata inside that same transaction; duplicate content rolls back both history and source position.

methods.name: processPackageUpload
methods.notes: Existing content-management authorization and package identity preflight remain required. Public demo uploads and replacements require the acting uploader to be an admin. Update summaries include structuralWarnings before content writes.

methods.name: getLearnerLessonAnalyticsHistoryPage
methods.notes: Existing learner lesson reauthorization and cursor limits retained; historical assessment copies are excluded.

methods.name: getLearnerLessonAnalyticsSource
methods.notes: Existing learner lesson authorization retained; copy exclusion applies to snapshot bounds, counts and pages.

methods.name: reportRecoverableWarning
methods.notes: Allowlisted citation, advisory output-size (including joint instruction generation), SPARC stale-question and content-removal-check diagnostics only. Removal-check errors retain bounded credential-redacted name, code and message without learner content, provider payloads or stacks. Server-owned reporter identity and existing rate limit; reads remain admin-only.

methods.name: resetOwnLessonProgress
methods.notes: Existing course reset restriction and canonical lesson-family scope retained. History deletion and its source repair revision commit together; no other learner's progress is reset.

methods.name: resetTdfConditionCounts
methods.notes: Existing owner/admin check retained. Reset clears the allocation block together with counts; saved participant assignments remain intact.

methods.name: saveTdfContent
methods.notes: Content-management authorization is rechecked on every save. Public demo content requires admin status independently of ownership or sharing. Risky authored-unit updates return confirmation-required with expectedRevision; confirmed writes compare tdfRevision atomically.

methods.name: saveTdfStimuli
methods.notes: Content-management authorization is rechecked on every save. Public demo content requires admin status independently of ownership or sharing. Question reductions return confirmation-required with expectedRevision; confirmed writes compare tdfRevision atomically.

methods.name: setExperimentState
methods.notes: Resume writes require current system existence and state ownership; archived or differently scoped state cannot be merged.

methods.name: updateExperimentState
methods.notes: Existing record ownership and root authorization retained. not-max state writes preserve the server-assigned condition atomically, including stale writes and replacement initialization.

methods.name: updateTdfConditionCounts
methods.notes: not-max count replacement additionally requires root ownership or admin role and clears the server-owned block. Other modes retain existing authorization.

methods.name: listSparcInstructionalComponents
methods.notes: Pages at most 24 shared components within one selected subgroup of the validated current browsing snapshot. Reads require an admin account, an existing subgroup and a valid type/distance cursor; stale snapshots and all-component requests are rejected. No embeddings or learner records are returned.

methods.name: lookupSparcPrimitive
methods.notes: Server-verified lesson access and own request identity retained. Exact-ID lookup cannot accept a component already used by this user; matched instructions check explanation, support and media separately. Transactional acceptance rejects stale/concurrent repeated selections. Same-request accepted decisions resume without reselection.

methods.name: publishSparcPrimitive
methods.notes: Server-verified lesson access, content validation and own request identity retained. Atomic accepted decisions reserve exact component identities for this user; generated instructions cannot include an already-used image or explanation. Historical usage initialization is bounded and derives original components from saved history, without publishing it.

methods.name: getSparcVideoCatalogTargets

methods.name: prepareSparcVideoCatalogTarget

methods.name: saveSparcVideoCatalogPassages

publications.name: tdfByIds
